overall: Atlanta is off to a cool start this morning with temperatures around 66°F at 06:49 ET after an overnight low near 64-65°F, well below the expected daytime high. The META model's center of mass sits near 87-88°F, and the NWS/HRRR consensus at 87°F is well-supported; ECMWF and NBM at 84.8°F represent the downside scenario if clouds develop or the heating trajectory underperforms. Confidence is moderate — the ensemble signals flag elevated uncertainty (Tier 4) due to model spread, but physical conditions favor the upper end of the guidance range near 87°F.
